$comment: Single source of truth for the Context Menu API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A menu that opens where you right-click or long-press, with the same items as Dropdown Menu.
thumb:
Right-click
Copy
Paste

children.description: The area that opens the menu.

content.description: The menu's items: DropdownMenuItem, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, Label and Separator.

label.description: Name for the menu, read by screen readers.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Right-click the area, long-press it on a touch screen, or focus it and press Shift+F10 or the Menu key. In HTML, add data-vin-context-menu and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Options and shortcuts
examples.description: Labels, keyboard shortcuts, and items that turn on and off.

a11y: The menu is the Dropdown Menu: role="menu", arrow keys, Home and End, type to jump, Esc or Tab to close.
The area is focusable, and Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens the menu at its corner, so it works without a mouse.
Focus goes into the menu when it opens and back to the area when it closes.
Shift+right-click still shows the browser's own menu.
Don't hide actions only in a context menu: offer them somewhere visible too.
